title: Mentorship and Peer Review in Biomedical AI
audience: Basic science learners practicing mentorship and peer-review communication
objectives: Identify communication, expectation, and role-dynamic problems in a mentoring relationship.
Draft a professional message that acknowledges both perspectives.
Reflect on skills for maintaining healthy mentor-mentee relationships.

sections.name: Scenario
sections.purpose: Introduce a strained mentor-mentee relationship around grant preparation.
sections.how_to_use: Read the case carefully and identify what each person needs and expects.

sections.name: Identify the Challenges
sections.purpose: Separate communication problems, expectation mismatches, and role dynamics.
sections.how_to_use: Write bullet points describing the main challenges, then optionally compare with the example.

sections.name: Draft a Professional Communication
sections.how_to_use: Draft a message that explains the issue, acknowledges the mentor's perspective, and proposes specific next steps.

sections.name: Reflection
sections.purpose: Connect the scenario to the learner's own mentoring practice.
sections.how_to_use: Write what skill matters most and how the approach could help in future relationships.

chatbot_guidance: When asked how to use this notebook, guide the learner through reading the case, identifying challenges, drafting the message, and reflecting.
Help learners make the message specific, respectful, and actionable.
Do not over-polish into corporate language; keep examples natural and professional.
